reviewer: Codex visual review of the actual 24 source frames after inference
method: Unmodified Qwen3 labels, evidence times, raw frame observations and grouping response. Neither this review nor the earlier source baseline was supplied to Qwen3.
report_hash_format: SHA-256 of UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=False

actions.note: The broad washing label covers lathered rubbing at 1.991565-10.953609s and a rinse sample at 11.949391s. Running water is not visible in most cited lather frames. Soap retrieval at 0s and the clear 12.945174s rinse sample are omitted.
13.940957 and 14.936739s support paper retrieval. 15.932522-19.915652s show hand drying; they do not support continued retrieval.

21.907217s shows a paper-covered door handle interaction, not bin disposal. 22.903s supports lowering a white towel into the lined bin, but release is occluded. The model combines two different interactions and reports disposal without uncertainty.

reference_flow.sequence: soap > lather > rinse > pull towel > dry > door handle > bin
reference_flow.summary: 3 coarse actions; drying/door missing, towel/bin evidence mixed. Full flow: UNVERIFIED.

limitations: One video is not an accuracy benchmark.
The baseline describes visible source actions, not a complete hygiene procedure.
No attention tensor, heatmap or calibrated confidence was measured.
The initial full run produced repeated actions and truncated JSON; its raw output remains published.
The retry changes the grouping prompt; it is not a controlled accuracy comparison with the earlier 3B full run.
